note: Computed from elevation grids with one method on both worlds. Model results, not field measurements. Catchments and upstream areas count only the part inside each map. The two grids differ in resolution (see cell_m), so small features on Jezero are not resolved.

basins.name: Lake Salda
basins.dataset: NASA SRTM 1 arc second, tile N37E029 (served by AWS Terrain Tiles)

lake.what: the flat lake surface recorded by SRTM

mask.encoding: two bits per cell, row by row from the north-west corner, least significant bits first; 0 = other land, 1 = catchment, 2 = lake

basins.name: Jezero Crater
basins.dataset: MGS MOLA MEGDR, MEGT44N000HB, 128 pixels per degree (NASA PDS Geosciences Node)

lake.what: the basin filled to -2430 m, the level used by the 3D page's ancient-lake view; a model, not a measured shoreline

mask.encoding: two bits per cell, row by row from the north-west corner, least significant bits first; 0 = other land, 1 = catchment, 2 = lake
